chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: Buddies with Lester Young on the road
summary: He and Lester roomed in the same houses on the road and shared a drink as buddies.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: So you and Lester got together a few times --

Yeah, we was kinda like buddies on the road, you know. We was kind of like buddies on the road. You know, you couldn't get into hotels down South and things like where we'd go. You know -- so you had to go to rooming houses. And he and I would always get a room in the same house. You know -- and that's the way it was I guess. We used to -- that made us real buddies, you know. We'd get into a house and order up a juice. You know -- we'd try to get a place where they sold the juice at. So that -- you know -- And we had a ball -- really had a ball.
